categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Xili Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electric energy metering products including smart meters (single-phase and three-phase), electricity information collection terminals, and energy metering boxes. The company also develops related products such as smart water meters, smart gateways, smart sockets, and mobile power supplies, expanding into public energy metering and power distribution markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in high-precision metering, software modular design, database middleware, control circuit design, communication, data security, and automated production. It has developed proprietary technologies such as high-reliability data storage middleware, adaptive power management, high-precision metering compensation algorithms, and automated production quality control systems (MES). The production is order-based with integrated ERP and MES systems ensuring traceability and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major power grid companies in China, including State Grid Corporation and Southern Power Grid, as well as provincial subsidiaries and local power companies. The products serve electricity utilities for metering and data collection in residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company also exports to Southeast Asia and Africa, targeting overseas power utilities and distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It serves nationwide power grid companies across multiple provinces. Additionally, it has expanded export sales to Southeast Asia and African markets, aligning with Belt and Road infrastructure projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xili Technology operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the electric energy metering supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of smart meters and related metering devices. It also produces some upstream components such as transformers and meter shells to ensure supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in smart metering technologies, focusing on developing next-generation smart meters compliant with new national standards (e.g., R46). It invests heavily in R&D (~5.7% of revenue), collaborates with universities and research institutes, and pursues modular product designs for rapid customization. Strategic priorities include expanding into smart grid, energy internet, and public energy metering, as well as increasing overseas market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart meters, electricity information collection terminals, and energy metering boxes. Sales are mainly conducted via bidding and contracts with power grid companies, supplemented by export sales and some direct business negotiations with industrial and commercial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's smart electric meter industry with a comprehensive product portfolio and advanced technology. It holds a strong market position evidenced by high supplier ratings (A-class) from State Grid and Southern Power Grid. Competitors include other domestic smart meter manufacturers, but Xili's integrated R&D, production automation, and quality management provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 587 million, a 3.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 103.7 million, up 39.31%. The company has shown steady growth with improving profitability and maintains a solid asset base of about RMB 1 billion. R&D investment remains significant to support innovation-driven growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xili Technology offers high-precision, low-power, multifunctional smart metering products with strong reliability and advanced communication capabilities. Its products integrate core proprietary technologies and comply with stringent national and international standards. The company emphasizes rapid technical response, modular design for customization, and comprehensive quality control, delivering superior value to power grid customers and supporting smart grid and energy internet development.
